# pcd_compute_flavor (Resource)

Manages a compute flavor in PCD's Nova service (admin). Flavors are immutable; any change forces a new resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk` (Number) Root disk in GB.
- `name` (String) The name of the flavor.
- `ram` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.

### Optional

- `ephemeral` (Number) Ephemeral disk in GB.
- `flavor_id` (String) The desired flavor ID (auto-generated if omitted).
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the flavor is public.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `rx_tx_factor` (Number) RX/TX factor.
- `swap` (Number) Swap space in MB.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The flavor ID.
